name: linux-main-ci
goal: Linux Full check passes: Tracker rehearsal rejects a duplicate with exit 1, cutover verification reads SQLite snapshots, and the Web workspace registry test fits its measured full-index cost

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Main Full check job 139905472453 (928c88cc3d): rehearsal duplicate --port expected exit 1 got 2; verify-cutover exit 2 'Unable to read SQLite snapshot'. Job 139921185581 (4bb678a83e): shared-workspace-registry showUnit test timed out at 60000ms. Both e2e failures reproduced in a node:24 + bun 1.2.18 Linux container.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Tests existed but sessions verify on macOS, where Apple SQLite always parses file: URIs and the OS ephemeral range (49152-65535) equals the accepted --port range; Linux Full check was the only Linux run and PRs merged while it was red or queued. The rehearsal helper never asserted the assigned port is acceptable to --port, so the cause surfaced as an unexplained exit 2; it now asserts the range. The registry test shared a 60s budget between two full repository indexes.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
